summary: First run testing of Skilleraa freelancing marketplace. All 19 backend pytest cases passed (100%). All frontend flows tested via Playwright pass (landing, login demo student, auth persistence on reload, jobs listing + Design filter, job apply flow, applied jobs page, student profile save, logout redirect to /login, route protection to /login when logged out, 404 page, about page). Backend fully covered, frontend critical paths covered.

issues: Two 'All' filter chips displayed side-by-side (one for Category, one for Experience) with no visual grouping labels — could confuse users. Consider labeling filter groups (e.g. 'Category:' / 'Experience:').

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~820 lines and mixes auth, models, routes, and seed data — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, jobs.py, applications.py, seed.py) for maintainability as the app grows.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True. With Starlette this works because of allow_origin_regex='.*' reflecting the request Origin, but it defeats the security intent of same-origin credential flows. Restrict origins to the actual frontend origin in production.
Refresh-token endpoint is not implemented — refresh cookie is set for 30 days but never used to renew the 1-day access token; on expiry the user must re-login.

GET /api/jobs/mine and /api/jobs/{job_id} are declared in the same router; FastAPI resolves in declaration order and /jobs/mine is declared BEFORE /jobs/{job_id}, which is correct. Just confirming no ordering bug.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data writes /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup — fine but noisy; guard with an idempotency check.
test_credentials: student@skilleraa.com / Student@1234 ; client@skilleraa.com / Client@1234 ; admin@skilleraa.com / Admin@1234
seed_data_creation: Backend seed_data() ran on startup. Test also created a few TEST_ users and one TEST_Job (deleted at end of flow test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 19 cases covering auth, profile, jobs CRUD, apply/save, applications status, dashboards, role RBAC). Frontend Playwright coverage includes: landing hero, demo-student login, auth persistence, jobs filter, apply with cover letter, profile save, logout, protected route redirect, 404, about. Client signup + post-job UI flows were not exercised via Playwright but the same endpoints pass at API level. Login demo student button is at [data-testid=login-demo-student] and pre-fills the form; caller still needs to click the submit button. Backend URL: https://minimal-job-platform.preview.emergentagent.com/api
